note: How each portal's leads reach a business, said honestly. `automatic`: the portal documents a way a business sets up itself, and we built the receiving side (switch in the hosting list). `account_manager`: no public lead API or webhook is documented for a business to use on its own; the portal's own team switches it on when asked. Every portal that sends lead e-mails can also send them straight to the lead e-mail address; that needs nothing from the portal's team. {WEB_ADDRESS} and {MAIL_ADDRESS} stand for the addresses shown once when the source was made; {PORTAL} for the portal's name.

portals.name: IndiaMART
ways: Your own key (Pull): paste your Lead Manager CRM key on the IndiaMART card. We fetch new leads every few minutes. The key lasts 7 days; the card says when it needs a new one.
IndiaMART Push API (a paid add-on): IndiaMART sends each lead to your web address the moment it arrives. No key, nothing to renew.
steps: Open the web address of your IndiaMART lead source here and copy it. If you have none yet, make one on the Webhook source card.
In seller.indiamart.com open Lead Manager, then Import/Export Leads, the three dots, then Push API.
Choose Other as the platform, type a name, and paste the web address as the Webhook Listener URL.
IndiaMART sends a code to your main mobile number. Type it in. The Push API is now on, and each new lead shows here by itself.
portals.switch: INDIAMART_PUSH (receiving the Push API body), INDIAMART_PULL (the scheduled pull with your own key)

portals.name: JustDial
portals.state: Available through your portal account manager
ways: Set the lead e-mail of your JustDial account to your lead e-mail address: each lead mail arrives here by itself.
Ask your JustDial account manager to send your leads to your web address (a lead API or webhook). JustDial does not publish this for businesses to switch on themselves.

portals.name: TradeIndia
portals.state: Available through your portal account manager
ways: Set the lead e-mail of your TradeIndia account to your lead e-mail address: each inquiry mail arrives here by itself.

TradeIndia shows an Inquiry API (User ID, Profile ID and API key) under My profile, Inquiries and Contacts, My Inquiry API, but it publishes no documentation of it for businesses. Ask TradeIndia to send your inquiries to your web address.
